title: dorycnium hirsutum var. hirtum
intro: Dorycnium hirsutum var. hirtum, commonly known as hairy tick clover, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, including treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of hairy tick clover include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic activities, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of hairy tick clover include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
